info.description: The Meeting Participants Retrieval API provides the capability to access information about participants in scheduled meetings. This endpoint allows users to query details regarding attendees for specific meetings, which can be vital for coordinating efforts and ensuring effective communication. Typically used by meeting organizers, teams, and collaboration tools, this API enables seamless integration and enhances visibility over meeting logistics. Users can retrieve comprehensive participant data to facilitate planning and engagement in various meeting scenarios.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of participants for meetings.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all participants associated with the meetings. It returns detailed information about each participant, which can be used for various business analytics and reporting purposes.
